English|obvious.summary: This message shows multiple clear indicators of a scam attempt, including artificial urgency, a suspicious unverified link, requests for your password and OTP, and an invitation to chat on Telegram. Do not click the link or share any information.
English|obvious.display_message: [URGENT] Official Trading Security Desk: Unusual withdrawal activity was detected on your trading account! Your wallet will be permanently frozen within 15 minutes unless you verify immediately at http://secure-trade-verify.top/auth and reply here with your login password and 6-digit SMS OTP code. For priority unlock, message our senior officer on Telegram @TradeDesk_VerifyNow.

flags.exact_phrase: Your wallet will be permanently frozen within 15 minutes
flags.plain_reason: Scammers create fake countdowns and strict deadlines to panic you into taking hasty actions before you can verify the claim.
This link uses a non-official domain (.top) designed to mimic legitimate trading platforms and steal your credentials.

flags.exact_phrase: reply here with your login password and 6-digit SMS OTP code
flags.plain_reason: Legitimate platforms will never ask you to send your account password or SMS OTP codes over chat or text.

flags.exact_phrase: message our senior officer on Telegram @TradeDesk_VerifyNow
flags.category: asks to move to another app
flags.plain_reason: Official support agents will not ask you to migrate conversations to third-party messaging apps like Telegram.

what_real_support_never_does: Never asks for your password, PIN, TAC, or SMS OTP codes.
Never threatens to permanently freeze your account within minutes over text or chat.
Never redirects support conversations to external personal channels like Telegram or WhatsApp.
safe_steps: Do not tap any links or reply to the message.
Open the official trading app or type the official website address yourself.
Contact support directly from inside the official app or website.
Never share your passwords, OTPs, PINs, or sensitive account details with anyone.

English|subtle.summary: This message is posing as compliance support and requesting remote access to your device, which is a major security risk. Real platform staff will never ask you to install remote desktop tools or message them privately on WhatsApp.
English|subtle.display_message: Hi Daniel, this is Marcus from the Account Compliance team following up on your recent P2P order #88412. To prevent a temporary compliance hold on your withdrawals, could you hop on a quick WhatsApp message at +60 11-3948 2201 or share your screen via AnyDesk so we can re-sync your trading session? No password needed.

flags.exact_phrase: To prevent a temporary compliance hold on your withdrawals
flags.plain_reason: Scammers create artificial pressure by threatening to freeze or restrict your withdrawals so you act without thinking.

flags.exact_phrase: hop on a quick WhatsApp message at +60 11-3948 2201
flags.category: asks to move to another app
flags.plain_reason: Official support communicates directly within the platform's app or website, not via personal WhatsApp accounts.

flags.exact_phrase: share your screen via AnyDesk so we can re-sync your trading session
flags.category: asks for remote access or payment
flags.plain_reason: AnyDesk allows someone to control your computer or phone remotely to steal funds and credentials, even if they claim 'no password needed'.

what_real_support_never_does: Never asks you to download remote access software like AnyDesk or TeamViewer.
Never requests you to move an official support inquiry to a personal WhatsApp or Telegram chat.
Never threatens to freeze your account unless you communicate with an unverified external contact.
safe_steps: Do not tap any links, call the number, or reply to this message.
Open the official trading app or manually type the platform's official website address yourself.
Contact support directly from inside the official app or website to check on order #88412.
Never share passwords, OTPs, SMS codes, or grant screen-sharing permissions to anyone.
